exit_criteria.text: reachability probe works against five games across engines
exit_criteria.detail: Four engines tested, four reached: Unreal Engine 4, DarkPlaces, Cube, id Tech 3. Four of four is stronger than the four-of-five asked for, but the denominator is not the protocol's, so the matrix records rather than closes it.

exit_criteria.text: camera calibration derives a usable ratio without a model
exit_criteria.detail: 0.0909 degrees per mouse unit on AssaultCube, wrap test, match confidence 1.000. Cross-checks against the columns-per-unit sweep at a field of view of about 110 degrees, and the two share no arithmetic.
